Layer.OnCommand: %function(self) self:cmd('x,SCREEN_CENTER_X;y,SCREEN_CENTER_Y;zoom,1.5;diffusealpha,0;fadetop,0.3;fadebottom,0.3;decelerate,1;zoomto,SCREEN_WIDTH+3,SCREEN_HEIGHT;') if not GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() or GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetBackgroundPath() == nil then self:diffusealpha(0) else self:diffusealpha(1) end self:fadetop(0); self:fadebottom(0); end

Layer.SetNowCommand:
%function(self) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then
if GAMESTATE:GetPlayMode() == 4 then GAMESTATE:ApplyGameCommand('mod, no left, no right, no mirror, no shuffle, no randomshuffle') end
self:settext( GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSteps(PLAYER_1):GetMeter() ) local Diff = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSteps(PLAYER_1):GetDifficulty()+1 for i=1,table.getn(DiffColorTable) do if Diff == i then self:diffuse( DiffColorTable[i][2][1],DiffColorTable[i][2][2],DiffColorTable[i][2][3],DiffColorTable[i][2][4] ) end end end
self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+500); self:zoom(0.6); self:bounceend(0.4); self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y-50); self:shadowlength(2); end

%function(self) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then
local Diff = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSteps(PLAYER_1):GetDifficulty()+1 for i=1,table.getn(DiffColorTable) do if Diff == i then self:diffuse( DiffColorTable[i][2][1],DiffColorTable[i][2][2],DiffColorTable[i][2][3],DiffColorTable[i][2][4] ) self:settext( DiffColorTable[i][1] ) end end self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+500); self:bounceend(0.4); self:zoom(0.4) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y-40) end
self:shadowlength(2); end

%function(self) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then
local Diff = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSteps(PLAYER_1):GetDifficulty()
self:diffuse(1,1,1,0.5) if GetStepsDescriptionText(PLAYER_1) == '' then self:settext( 'By: Not Set!' ) self:diffuse(1,0,0,0.5) else self:settext( 'By: '..GetStepsDescriptionText(PLAYER_1) ) end self:zoom(0.4) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+500); self:bounceend(0.4); self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y-25); end
self:shadowlength(2); end
